panels.title: Guest health matrix
panels.description: Inventory includes stopped on-demand guests as of the last checker scan. Blank policy means inventory is stale. VM CPU is measured inside the VM; container CPU is percent of one core (may exceed 100). OpenBSD RAM is active+wired / pages, WAN uses MemAvailable; container RAM includes cache. svc free is its tightest qgroup headroom; other containers have no filesystem exporter. Exporter is scrape health, not a service probe; Network and Monitoring show services. Updates/restarts are in the lifecycle log below.
